title: ARSIA Explanation
description: Structured account of the agent's reasoning, included in response messages as payload.explanation when the action's explainability_required flag is true. Implements EU AI Act Article 13 transparency obligations. Defined in ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2. Note: when alternatives_considered is present (RECOMMENDED for risk_level ≥ 7), each element supports Article 14(4)(c) by showing what the agent decided and what it considered and rejected.

reasoning.description: Human-readable explanation of why this action was taken or this result was produced, written in plain language a non-technical person can understand. SHOULD describe inputs considered, logic applied, and conclusion reached. MUST NOT contain raw model outputs, token probabilities, or other machine-readable representations not meaningful to a human reader. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2 'reasoning'.

confidence.description: The agent's confidence in the decision or recommendation, expressed as a decimal between 0.0 (no confidence) and 1.0 (absolute confidence). MUST reflect the agent's actual assessment — MUST NOT be hardcoded. When the internal model does not produce a confidence score, a calibrated estimate SHOULD be used. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2 'confidence'.

inputs_used.description: List of identifiers for the inputs that influenced the decision. Each string SHOULD be traceable to a specific data source, state entry, or external input (e.g. 'state:client-profile/risk-tolerance', 'message:a1b2c3d4-...', 'external:bloomberg/AAPL/price'). Per ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2 'inputs_used'.

alternatives_considered.description: Alternative options the agent evaluated and chose not to pursue. OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED for risk_level ≥ 7. Supports EU AI Act Article 14(4)(c) interpretability by showing not just what the agent decided, but what it considered and rejected. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2 'alternatives_considered'.

option.description: Description of the alternative option. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2 'alternatives_considered.option'.

reason_rejected.description: Why this alternative was not chosen. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2 'alternatives_considered.reason_rejected'.

confidence.description: The agent's confidence in this alternative (0.0 to 1.0), enabling comparison with the chosen option. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2 'alternatives_considered.confidence'.

model_version.description: Version identifier of the machine learning model used to make this decision, if any. Aids reproducibility and audit. Format is implementation-defined but SHOULD include a model name and a version or commit hash (e.g. 'gpt-4o-2025-08-06', 'risk-model-v2.3.1-abc123'). Per ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2 'model_version'.

allOf.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with millisecond precision and UTC designator. When the agent made the decision, which may differ from the message's 'ts' field if there was a delay between decision and response construction. When present, MUST be earlier than or equal to the message's 'ts' value (enforced programmatically). Per ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2 'decision_timestamp'.
